companies.title: Lifecycle stage
companies.description: Where the account is in the funnel. Set by W1 (MQL), SDR, W3 (Customer). Used by team views and funnel reporting.

companies.title: Segment
companies.description: Size band, set by the SDR at qualification from employee count / expected ACV. Used by W1 round-robin routing.

companies.title: SDR owner
companies.description: SDR working the account. Set by W1. Used by SDR views and the SDR Queue.

companies.title: CSM owner
companies.description: CSM after the sale. Set by W3. Receives W4 tasks and Slack alerts.

companies.title: Health
companies.description: Worst usage signal across the company's product workspaces. Set by W4. Used by CS views and renewal prep.

people.title: Lifecycle stage
people.description: Funnel stage for the individual. Set by W1 and SDR. Used by SDR views and W6 exit rules.

people.title: Lead source
people.description: How the person first came in. Set by W1 (from Typeform) or SDR. Used by the Leads by source report.

people.title: UTM campaign
people.description: Synced from Typeform hidden field by W1. Used for campaign attribution in the warehouse.

people.title: UTM source
people.description: Synced from Typeform hidden field by W1. Used for channel attribution in the warehouse.

people.title: Form intent
people.description: High = demo / contact sales form, Low = content download. Set by W1. Low intent goes to nurture.

people.title: First touch at
people.description: When an SDR first contacted the person. Set by SDR or W2. Drives the speed-to-lead report against the 1-hour SLA.

deals.title: Deal type
deals.description: New, Expansion or Renewal. Set by AE (W5 sets Renewal). Picks the W3 branch; drives NRR in the warehouse.

deals.title: Plan
deals.description: Plan being sold. Set by AE. Copied to the subscription by W3. Plans map 1:1 to segments.

deals.title: Seats
deals.description: Total seats on the subscription after this deal closes. Set by AE. Copied to seats_purchased by W3.

deals.title: Price per seat
deals.description: Extra-user rate per year: list ($240 Growth/Business, $200 Enterprise) or negotiated. Set by AE. Copied to the subscription by W3.

deals.title: Resulting ARR
deals.description: Subscription ARR after this deal closes. Set by AE. Copied to the subscription's arr by W3. (Value = ARR this deal adds.)

deals.title: Economic buyer
deals.description: Person who signs off on budget. Set by AE. Used by the committee coverage view.

deals.title: Champion
deals.description: Person selling CloudScale internally. Set by AE. Used by the committee coverage view.

deals.title: Technical evaluator
deals.description: Data or IT lead running the evaluation. Set by AE. Used in Technical Evaluation and security review.

deals.title: Close date
deals.description: Expected or actual close date. Set by AE. Used by forecast views.

deals.title: Loss reason
deals.description: Why the deal was lost. Set by AE at Closed Lost. Used by loss analysis and W6 nurture.

deals.title: SDR (sourced by)
deals.description: SDR who booked the demo. Set by W1 or SDR. Used for SDR credit and pipeline-sourced reporting.

subscriptions.title: Name
subscriptions.description: Contract term, e.g. 'Acme — 2026–27'. Set by W3.

subscriptions.title: Status
subscriptions.description: Onboarding → Active → Renewal Due → Renewed, or Churned. Set by W3, CSM and W5. Filters total_arr.

subscriptions.title: Plan
subscriptions.description: Current plan. Set by W3. Used by the ARR by plan report and as paywall context for W4.

subscriptions.title: ARR
subscriptions.description: Annual recurring revenue on this term: base price + (seats − included) × price per seat. Set by W3 from the deal's resulting_arr.

subscriptions.title: Seats purchased
subscriptions.description: Seats paid for; never below the plan's included users (25 / 75 / 225). Set by W3. Used by the n8n seat utilisation calculation.

subscriptions.title: Price per seat
subscriptions.description: Extra-user rate on this contract; negotiated on Enterprise. Set by W3. Used by CSMs to quote seat expansions.

subscriptions.title: Start date
subscriptions.description: Term start. Set by W3 or AE. A renewed term starts on the old term's end date.

subscriptions.title: End date
subscriptions.description: Term end. Set by W3 or AE. W5 opens the renewal deal 90 days before this date.

subscriptions.title: Auto-renew
subscriptions.description: Renews automatically unless cancelled. Set by AE. Used for renewal risk in CS views.

product_workspaces.title: Name
product_workspaces.description: Synced from n8n usage sync. Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme — US'.

product_workspaces.title: Workspace ID
product_workspaces.description: Synced from n8n usage sync. The product's own tenant ID; the n8n upsert key, so syncs never create duplicates.

product_workspaces.title: Seats used
product_workspaces.description: Synced from n8n usage sync. Users currently holding a seat.

product_workspaces.title: Seat utilisation (%)
product_workspaces.description: Synced from n8n usage sync. seats_used ÷ subscription seats_purchased × 100. W4 Seats expansion at ≥ 90.

product_workspaces.title: Weekly active users
product_workspaces.description: Synced from n8n usage sync. Users active in the last 7 days. Feeds Company active_users and health.

product_workspaces.title: WAU change 30d (%)
product_workspaces.description: Synced from n8n usage sync. % change in weekly active users over 30 days. W4 risk at ≤ −30.

product_workspaces.title: Departments active
product_workspaces.description: Synced from n8n usage sync. Departments (user groups) with active users. W4 New department expansion when it goes up.

product_workspaces.title: Paywall hits (30d)
product_workspaces.description: Synced from n8n usage sync. Attempts to use a feature above the plan. W4 Plan upgrade expansion at ≥ 10.

product_workspaces.title: Last active at
product_workspaces.description: Synced from n8n usage sync. Last time anyone used the workspace. W4 risk after 14 days inactive.

product_workspaces.title: Last synced at
product_workspaces.description: Synced from n8n usage sync. Last successful sync; spots a broken sync.

product_workspaces.title: Usage signal
product_workspaces.description: Set by W4 from the usage rules. Used by the Accounts by usage signal report and the Company health rollup.

product_workspaces.title: Expansion reason
product_workspaces.description: Set by W4. Tells the CSM what to pitch; the warehouse measures which reasons convert.

relationships.title: Company
relationships.description: Account that owns this contract term. Set by W3.

relationships.title: Originating deal
relationships.description: Deal that created this term (new business or renewal). Set by W3.

relationships.title: Renewal deal
relationships.description: Deal renewing this term. Set by W5 at end date − 90 days.

relationships.title: Expands subscription
relationships.description: Subscription this expansion deal grows. Set by AE or CSM. Tells W3 which subscription to update.

relationships.title: Company
relationships.description: Synced from n8n usage sync (first sync). Owning account.

relationships.title: Subscription
relationships.description: Synced from n8n usage sync (first sync). Contract covering this workspace; source of seats_purchased.

relationships.title: Users
relationships.description: Synced from n8n usage sync. People using this workspace.

attributes.title: Status
attributes.description: New → Contacted → Qualified, or Nurture / Disqualified. Set by W1 (New) and SDR. Triggers W2 SLA alert and W6 nurture.

attributes.title: SLA due at
attributes.description: When first contact is due (created + 1 hour). Set by W1. Used by the W2 overdue alert.

attributes.title: DQ reason
attributes.description: Why the lead was disqualified. Set by SDR. Lead-quality feedback to marketing.

attributes.title: Stage
attributes.description: Onboarding progress. Set by W3 (Kickoff) and CSM. Time-in-stage = time to value.

attributes.title: Subscription
attributes.description: Contract being onboarded. Set by W3. Links onboarding to revenue.

attributes.title: Target go-live
attributes.description: Planned go-live. Set by CSM. Used by the late-onboarding view.

attributes.title: Go-live date
attributes.description: Actual go-live. Set by CSM. Used by the late-onboarding view.
